validation.skuFormat: Use letters, numbers and . _ / - only (no spaces at the start).
validation.slugFormat: Use lower-case letters, numbers and single hyphens.
validation.codeFormat: Use upper-case letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
validation.countryCode: Use a two-letter ISO country code (e.g. SA).
validation.moneyFormat: Enter an amount such as 125 or 125.50.
validation.moneyPrecision: Use at most two decimal places.
validation.moneyPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
validation.compareAtGreater: The compare-at price must be higher than the price.
validation.barcodeLength: Wrong number of digits for the selected barcode type.
validation.barcodeChecksum: The check digit is invalid — please re-scan or re-type the barcode.
validation.barcodeInternalFormat: Internal codes must start with 2–4 letters followed by letters, digits or hyphens.
validation.barcodeSourceMismatch: Internally assigned codes must use Code 128; GTINs come only from the manufacturer.
validation.barcodeTypeRequired: Select the barcode type and source.
validation.passwordContainsIdentity: The password must not contain your e-mail name.
validation.primaryCategoryNotSelected: The primary category must be one of the selected categories.
validation.sizeMl: Enter a volume in millilitres, e.g. 50 or 7.5.
validation.dateOrder: The expiry date must be after the issue date.
validation.timezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone (e.g. Asia/Riyadh).
validation.duplicateNote: Each note can only appear once per layer.
validation.scopeTargetRequired: Select the {scope} this role applies to.
validation.quantity: Enter a whole number of units between 1 and {max}.
validation.taxNumberFormat: This tax number does not match the format for the supplier's country.
validation.paymentTermDays: Enter the number of credit days (1–365).
validation.variantNotFound: No variant has this SKU or barcode.
validation.lotNumberFormat: Use letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, slashes and periods (up to 64).
validation.labelDate: Enter a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM for month and year only.
validation.calendarDate: Enter a full date as YYYY-MM-DD.
validation.expiryOutcomeDate: Leave the date empty unless the outcome is a label date.
validation.expiryAfterManufacture: The expiry date must be after the manufacturing date.
